headline: Russia unleashes massive coordinated drone assault across multiple Ukrainian regions
subheadline: Over 30 Shahed and reactive UAV groups launched from six Russian airbases, striking Kyiv, Odesa and other regions, hitting the Novus shopping center.
lede: Russian forces executed a massive coordinated drone assault overnight, launching more than 30 Shahed and reactive UAV groups from six airbases across twelve Ukrainian regions, striking the Novus shopping center in Vyshneve and prompting rescue of a live child. Meanwhile, Israeli troops killed three Palestinian Islamic Jihad operatives in Gaza City's Tel al-Hawa neighborhood, while Iran conducted missile launches and activated air defenses in Khuzestan, Isfahan, East Azerbaijan and Kurdistan provinces. Lebanese Prime Minister Nawaf Salam and the Education Minister condemned an IDF Arabic spokesperson's school visit in Dbl, South Lebanon, and Bahrain's Interior Ministry issued an alert after smoke and ambulance dispatches.

sections.title: Massive Drone Assault Across Ukraine Overnight
sections.body: Russian forces launched over 30 Shahed and reactive UAV groups from at least six airbases, including Primorsko‑Akhtarsk, Orel, Millerovo, Gvardeyskoye, Shatalovo and Kursk, targeting Kyiv, Vinnytsia, Dnipropetrovsk, Kharkiv, Odesa and other regions. A reactive Shahed struck the Novus shopping center in Vyshneve, Kyiv region, leading rescue teams to extract a live child from the rubble. Ukrainian forces repelled Russian advances near Ustynivka in Donetsk while Russian troops pushed toward Verkhnya Tersa, and USV attacks sank the Russian corvette Mercury near Libya, damaging the sanctioned roller ASCALON.

sections.title: Israeli Strike in Gaza, Iran Missile Activity
sections.body: Israeli forces struck three Palestinian Islamic Jihad operatives in Gaza City's Tel al-Hawa neighborhood, killing them according to Palestinian media. Iran launched missiles from the 15 Khordad Garrison in Isfahan and a UAV from Omidiyeh Fifth Tactical Air Base in Khuzestan, with heavy anti‑aircraft activity reported in Omidiyeh and Dorcheh. Lebanese Prime Minister Nawaf Salam and the Education Minister condemned an IDF Arabic spokesperson's visit to a school in Dbl, South Lebanon, while Bahrain's Interior Ministry issued an alert after smoke was seen and ambulances dispatched.

sections.title: Intelligence Assessment
sections.body: The Israeli operation in Gaza targeting PIJ leadership coincides with Iran’s simultaneous missile launches and air‑defense activations across multiple provinces, suggesting a coordinated escalation. High‑level Lebanese condemnation of an IDF school visit, Bahrain’s security alert and CENTCOM’s denial of Iranian F‑16 claims further indicate heightened regional tension and strategic uncertainty.
